idea-plugin.name: PHP Chinese Manual
idea-plugin.description:
PHP Chinese Manual brings Chinese PHP documentation directly into PhpStorm.

Place the caret on a PHP built-in function, class, method, constant, or predefined variable, then open Quick Documentation to view its Chinese description without leaving the IDE.

The bundled documentation is generated from the official PHP Chinese manual and JetBrains phpstorm-stubs by the phpstorm-stubs-chinese project.

PHP Chinese Manual 将 PHP 中文文档直接集成到 PhpStorm 中。

将光标放在 PHP 内置函数、类、方法、常量或预定义变量上，打开“快速文档”即可在 IDE 内查看中文说明，无需跳转浏览器。
